audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 is right: Vex owns 1-3 on range, Cass flips 4-5 (Miasma grounding + Twin Fang sustain) and first item (tear/Lost Chapter machine-gun E), Vex reasserts at 6 and 2+ items. Content layer states this correctly; 58.13% WR over 406 games.
Spikes correct and correctly named: Noxious Blast (Q), Miasma (W, grounding), Twin Fang (E), Petrifying Gaze (R). The old 'Noxious Blight' fabrication does not appear in current text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagreed with content/packet on all 7 rows (blanket Skill x6 plus Cassiopeia on row 6, where content says Vex). 22 lint findings: widespread he/his for a she/her champion, two Do's/Don'ts bodies pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad, cooldowns field with no digit. Trading text was dash-keyed against a champion with no dash. The critical interaction — Miasma grounds Vex, disabling her R recast dash inside the pool — is now stated with Miasma's 24/16s cooldown; anti-heal vs Twin Fang sustain (missing interaction) folded into dontsFull[2] and report[8].
audit.why: Grounding disables Movement abilities per Riot's Miasma text and Vex's R recast is a dash; Twin Fang heals per hit on poisoned targets, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to content layer with grounded whys; pronouns corrected throughout; real cooldowns added (Miasma 24-16s, Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80).
